question: Can the selected narrow Sacramento-owned C++23 composition provide a viable foundation for the initial Windows Trainee Client and Debian Session Authority baseline?

issue_evidence.finding: Ubuntu-hosted Clang produced reproducible Windows PE and Debian ELF artifacts, and the composed client ran natively on Windows/NVIDIA against the Debian authority.

Falcor selected Vulkan, Slang produced identified reproducible SPIR-V, and the native composed client created a Slang compute pass on an NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti; Falcor requires a maintained vendor capsule.
The Debian Session Authority proofs exclude Falcor, Vulkan, Slang runtime compilation, Steam Audio, Assimp, Tracy, CUDA, OptiX, and PhysXGpu from the applicable authority closures.

A Blender-origin Map fixture cooks deterministically through a Sacramento interchange into a versioned runtime package containing stable anchor, material, shader, collision, and integrity identities without runtime importer/editor dependencies.

One rendered role plus three synthetic clients reproduced exact ordered 120-tick output, and the literal Windows rendered client later exchanged the same Sacramento protocol with Debian; Controlled LAN recovery and production admission remain unproved.
The authoritative core ran a representative CPU-only PhysX contact for 240 fixed 60 Hz ticks with byte-identical canonical traces; broader cross-platform and profile coverage is unproved.
A Sacramento-owned authoritative arrival timestamp drove Steam Audio distance, occlusion, transmission, and HRTF output; the same PCM identity was reproduced natively in the composed Windows client.
The structured writer emitted the required prototype identity and correlation subset; CoreOnly excludes Tracy while Diagnostic includes it, and the native composed client emitted CoreOnly signals.

Exact versions, hashes, closures, licences, sizes, build observations, adapter surfaces, and update procedures are recorded, but vulnerability disposition, offline mirrors, consolidated SBOM, supported-toolchain claims, and one real patch-version upgrade are incomplete.
Boundary audits found no selected vendor type in Sacramento public headers, persistent runtime packages, network messages, or the demonstrated canonical component schema.

architecture_drivers.finding: The prototype is a narrow need-specific Simulation Engine foundation, not a general engine; Assimp is cooker-only and no custom graphical editor was introduced.
One Session Authority owns canonical ticks and results, but Operational Clock, Trusted Identity Time, Technical Pause, continuity, and complete State Restoration were not implemented.

Representative deterministic physics and Acoustic Propagation seams work, but closed catalogues, Ballistic Projectile behavior, atomic multi-domain transitions, and broad spatial/profile coverage remain product work.

The offline source-to-runtime seam proves identity, versioning, integrity, and importer isolation for one Map fragment; atomic activation, history, compatibility, and closed catalogue admission remain unspecified.

GNS is successfully isolated as transport, but mutual authentication, AUTH Protected Exchange, Admission, offline validation, continuity, durable audit commit, expiry, and recovery were not prototyped.

The mandated Windows 11 and Debian 13 artifact paths work with Ubuntu-hosted Clang and native Windows acceptance, subject to the enumerated Falcor, vcpkg, CMake, triplet, and vendor-support exceptions.
Smoke timings show functional headroom only; no approved Reference Workload Profile measured the 16.67 ms presentation, 100 ms action, Admission, fidelity, availability, or stress criteria.

A versioned core signal subset, deterministic evidence, and diagnostic separation are proven; loss accounting, buffering, collection, retention, integrity, clock offsets, and complete dependency-driven reverification are unproved.

selection_dimensions.finding: Canonical consistency seams pass narrowly; training validity, safety profiles, AUTH security/audit integrity, and recovery require later architecture and evidence.
No final-image or end-to-end action workload was measured against the approved thresholds.

Physics, network ordering, cooked content, builds, and signal fixtures are repeatable in isolation; one complete Personnel Recovery replay and loss-detectable production observability path are absent.
The Blender-origin Map path is deterministic, versioned, integrity-bound, preinstallable, and free of runtime Blender/Assimp/OpenUSD dependencies.
Applicable Windows and Debian cross-build/package/runtime paths pass at prototype scale, with native Windows client and Debian authority execution and explicit unsupported vendor paths.
Vendor coupling is localized to adapters and overlays; Falcor remains the outlier because its vendor capsule needs three maintained patches and a large packaged dependency surface.
Per-gate clean build and dependency costs plus package sizes are recorded, but no clean integrated spine build or representative developer iteration distribution was measured.

Exact source identities, licence files, closure inventories, and update procedures exist; no candidate-wide patch upgrade, vulnerability disposition, offline mirror, or consolidated SBOM was completed.

The narrow adapters are credible individually, but the combined custom triplets, overlays, Falcor capsule and patches, two-platform acceptance, and broad unproved product seams do not yet establish the mandatory two-generalist ceiling.

exceptions.summary: Authorize maintained Vulkan-only Falcor patches and Packman only inside an integrity-controlled offline vendor capsule, or replace Falcor.
Reconcile repository CMake 4.2.3 with vcpkg-required CMake 4.4.0 and seal every host helper, including GNU Make where retained.
Create one supported production cross-vcpkg profile for find roots, Release try_compile, CRT, C++23, and reproducible clang-cl path maps.
Accept and own unsupported Clang 22/Debian 13 PhysX and Linux-hosted clang-cl Steam Audio/Tracy paths, or select supported versions.
Approve and qualify OpenSSL on Debian plus BCrypt on Windows, or choose one cross-platform crypto dependency; neither substitutes for AUTH Protected Exchange.

unproved: Complete Reference Personnel Recovery Scenario vertical replay
AUTH, Admission, offline trust, durable audit commit, continuity, and State Restoration
Controlled LAN loss, congestion, reconnect, recovery, and 16-client stress
Approved 16.67 ms presentation and 100 ms authoritative-action workloads
Representative Evaluator visual and acoustic validity and peak coverage
Real-time audio/device path, reflections, pathing, and stress behavior
Live Tracy capture, profiling overhead, and complete production observability transport
Candidate-wide vulnerability disposition, consolidated SBOM, and offline dependency reconstruction
One patch-version upgrade with measured adapter churn
Demonstrated ongoing maintenance within two concurrent human generalists
next_decision: Issue #13 must decide whether the conditional viability and five exception classes justify confirming ADR-0003's selected strategy.
